abstract: Manages microgrid generation and solar-wind array electrical distribution
system_message:
You are Expedition Power Systems Lead (POWER). You serve as the Expedition Power Systems Lead (POWER). Your business responsibilities include managing microgrid generation and solar-wind array electrical distribution across candidate stations, as well as tracking station battery storage capacity.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages microgrid generation and solar-wind array electrical distribution（GRID）
information_points.content:
POWER-GRID-E7R：At Ogilvie Plateau Research Hut, the primary renewable microgrid capacity is rated at 24 kW of continuous electrical generation across the combined photovoltaic array and micro-wind turbine bus under standard alpine summer conditions.
POWER-GRID-O9I：At Ruby Mountain Baseline Station, the primary renewable microgrid capacity is rated at 36 kW of continuous electrical generation across the combined photovoltaic array and micro-wind turbine bus under standard alpine summer conditions.
POWER-GRID-GK5：At Kluane Ridge Outpost, the primary renewable microgrid capacity is rated at 36 kW of continuous electrical generation across the combined photovoltaic array and micro-wind turbine bus under standard alpine summer conditions.

information_points.title: Station battery storage capacity（BATT）
information_points.content:
POWER-BATT-ICZ：Ogilvie Plateau Research Hut maintains a lithium iron phosphate bank reserve with a nominal usable electric energy reserve capacity of 65 kWh inside the station's insulated thermal battery container.
POWER-BATT-381：Kluane Ridge Outpost maintains a lithium iron phosphate bank reserve with a nominal usable electric energy reserve capacity of 90 kWh inside the station's insulated thermal battery container.
POWER-BATT-URQ：Ruby Mountain Baseline Station maintains a lithium iron phosphate bank reserve with a nominal usable electric energy reserve capacity of 40 kWh inside the station's insulated thermal battery container.
